name: AgentReaderMark
about: The art director's own sculpt of the agent piece for release 2 (caught-mark-r2.obj, from her scripts figs.py, spy3d.py and sheet.py), turned into the game's model file by Tools/obj_to_model.py. One unit is the figure, from the base's top to the hat's crown. The mark left for a month where an agent was caught: the empty base, with his hat lying on it brim-down beside a folded newspaper.
